title: Vision screening at least once in children aged 3 to 5 years

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends vision screening at least once in all children aged 3 to 5 years to detect amblyopia or its risk factors.

action: Perform vision screening at least once between ages 3 and 5 years to detect amblyopia or its risk factors.

derived.window: the text says at least once during ages 3 to 5 (a 3-year span), so a lookback of the measurement year plus the 2 prior years is assumed. For younger children this window can include screens done before age 3, and 3-4 year olds not yet screened are flagged as due rather than overdue.
